选择网络，填写固定收款钱包和支持的代币，用你的钱包部署收款合约；已有合约可以直接: Select a network, enter a fixed payout wallet and supported tokens, then deploy the payment acceptance contract using your wallet. Existing contracts can be imported directly.
核对固定收款钱包和支持币种: Check the Fixed Payout Wallet and Supported Tokens
部署完成后，在“链与合约”中核对。这两项写入合约后不可修改。: After deployment, check these under Chains & Contracts. These two settings cannot be changed once written into the contract.
获取部署 ID 和代币 CA，按示例从商城服务器创建订单、接收付款通知。: Get the deployment ID and token CA, then follow the examples to create orders from your store server and receive webhooks.
之前发起过部署但尚未完成。请先查看记录，避免重复部署。: A previous deployment was initiated but is not complete. Check the records first to avoid deploying again.
<当前部署支持的代币 CA>: <token CA supported by the current deployment>
商城服务器通过 API 创建收款订单，把收银台链接交给顾客；付款确认后后台发送签: Your store server creates payment acceptance orders through the API and gives customers the checkout link. The admin console sends signed webhooks once payments are confirmed.
订单只属于创建它的部署。每次下单都要带上部署 ID，并使用该部署支持的准确代币: An order belongs only to the deployment that created it. Every order request must include the deployment ID and an exact token CA supported by that deployment.
当前部署尚未配置。: The current deployment has not been configured yet.
amount 必须是十进制字符串，不能用浮点数或科学计数，小数位不能超过该币种的: amount must be a decimal string, not a floating-point number or scientific notation. Its decimal places must not exceed the token's decimals.
reference 是商城自己的订单号，在同一部署内幂等：参数相同会返回原订单，: reference is your store's order number and is idempotent within the same deployment: identical parameters return the original order; different parameters are rejected.
请保存返回的 id、deploymentId、address 和 checkou: Save the returned id, deploymentId, address, and checkoutPath.
webhookUrl 的域名需要服务器启动时通过 UPAY_WEBHOOK_HO: The webhookUrl domain must be allowed through UPAY_WEBHOOK_HOSTS when the server starts.
发给顾客。收银台只显示该订单的付款信息，不需要登录。: to the customer. The checkout page only shows payment information for that order and requires no login.
顾客需要在正确的链上，向订单收款地址转入订单指定的代币。转错币种或转错链都不会计: The customer must transfer the token specified by the order to the order's payment address on the correct chain. Transfers of the wrong token or on the wrong chain do not count toward payment.
payment.paid（已确认付足）、payment.reversed（链重组: payment.paid (confirmed fully paid), payment.reversed (reversed by a chain reorganization)
HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + \".\" + 原始正文)，密钥: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + "." + raw request body), using webhook.secret in the server's data directory as the key
返回 2xx 才算送达；失败会自动重试，最多 8 次: Delivery is successful only on a 2xx response. Failures are retried automatically, up to 8 times.
同一订单可能因链重组先撤回、再重新确认，届时会收到新的事件 ID。请以订单号 +: A chain reorganization may reverse an order's payment and then confirm it again, generating new event IDs. Use the order number and latest stateVersion to decide whether to fulfill the order. Do not fulfill it again for every payment event received.
下单时填写了 webhookUrl 的订单，在付款确认或被撤回时会通知商城。: Orders created with a webhookUrl notify your store when payment is confirmed or reversed.
已重新排队。这不代表商城已经收到。: Requeued. This does not mean the store has received it.
后台向商城发送签名的 HTTP 通知。“已送达”只表示商城返回了 2xx，不等于: The admin console sends signed HTTP webhooks to your store. Delivered only means the store returned 2xx; it does not mean the order has been fulfilled.
已自动重试 8 次。请确认商城接收地址可用后重新排队，事件 ID 不变，商城应按: Automatically retried 8 times. Check that the store's receiving endpoint is available, then requeue. The event ID remains unchanged; the store should deduplicate by event ID.
提示：同一订单在链重组后可能先收到“撤回”、再收到新的“付款已确认”。商城应以订: Note: After a chain reorganization, the same order may receive a reversal event followed by a new Payment Confirmed event. Your store should use the order number and current order status to decide whether to fulfill it. Do not fulfill it again for every payment webhook received.
搜索订单号、收款地址: Search by order number or payment address
订单由商城服务器通过 API 创建，创建后会出现在这里。: Orders are created by your store server through the API and appear here after creation.
调整筛选条件后再试。: Adjust the filters and try again.
订单由商城通过 API 创建。付款状态来自链上到账记录，归集状态来自归集交易回执: Orders are created by your store through the API. Payment status comes from on-chain deposit records; sweep status comes from sweep transaction receipts. They are shown separately.
当前部署下找不到这笔订单: Order Not Found in the Current Deployment
它可能属于另一个部署。订单只在创建它的部署下查询。: It may belong to another deployment. Orders can only be queried within the deployment that created them.
付足后才能归集: Full payment is required before sweeping
资金仍在订单收款地址。: Funds remain at the order's payment address.
这部分不计入订单付款。资金在订单地址中，可以归集，但需要和顾客、商城人工核实如何: This amount does not count toward the order's payment. The funds are at the order address and can be swept, but how to handle them must be verified manually with the customer and store.
这个地址还收到了其他支持币种: This Address Also Received Other Supported Tokens
其他币种不计入本订单付款，也不换算。可在下方“高级”中单独归集。: Other tokens do not count toward this order's payment and are not converted. They can be swept separately under Advanced below.
其他币种 · 不计入付款: Other Tokens · Not Counted Toward Payment
这两项不改变订单币种，也不计入付款，资金只会进入固定收款钱包。: Neither action changes the order token or counts toward payment. Funds can only go to the fixed payout wallet.
需要已付足且未归集，并且没有进行中的交易: Requires full payment, no prior sweep, and no transaction in progress
固定收款钱包和支持币种在合约部署时写死，之后不可修改。: The fixed payout wallet and supported tokens are set permanently when the contract is deployed and cannot be changed afterward.
钱包可能已经发出交易。请登记原交易哈希或按流程结案，不要重复发起。: The wallet may already have sent the transaction. Register the original transaction hash or follow the resolution process. Do not initiate it again.
付款状态可能不是最新的。请检查该链 RPC 是否可用。: Payment statuses may be out of date. Check whether this chain's RPC is available.
资金仍在订单地址，可在处理原因后重新归集。: Funds remain at the order addresses. You can sweep again after addressing the cause.
商城可能还不知道这些订单已付款。: The store may not yet know that these orders have been paid.
过期后到账不计入订单付款，需要人工核实处理。: Funds received after expiry do not count toward order payment and require manual verification and handling.
正在查看 {0} 的部署。切换右上角部署不会影响其他链的扫描。: Viewing the deployment on {0}. Switching deployments at the top right does not affect scanning on other chains.
结果未知的交易、失败通知和同步异常会出现在这里。: Transactions with unknown results, failed webhooks, and sync issues appear here.
已付足、尚未归集的订单，按币种分别统计。: Fully paid orders that have not yet been swept, grouped by token.
这是按付款记录估算的金额。实际归集按执行时订单地址的链上余额，包含超额部分；不同: These amounts are estimated from payment records. Actual sweeps use each order address's on-chain balance at execution time, including overpayments. Different tokens are not combined or converted to fiat.
订单由商城通过 API 自动创建。: Orders are created automatically by your store through the API.
会话、钱包连接、手机入口和当前部署的运行状态。: Session, wallet connections, mobile access, and operational status of the current deployment.
浏览器 HttpOnly Cookie，8 小时有效；本页面不保存密钥: Browser HttpOnly cookie, valid for 8 hours; this page does not store the key
按需临时开放（Cloudflare Quick Tunnel，最长 5 分钟）: Temporary access on demand (Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, up to 5 minutes)
手机入口只开放本批专用页面，不暴露管理后台。关闭入口不会取消已签名的交易。: Mobile access exposes only the dedicated page for this batch, not the admin console. Closing access does not cancel signed transactions.
正式订单应由商城 API 创建；这里只用于测试或补单。: Production orders should be created through your store's API integration. This is only for testing or manually creating missing orders.
使用 WalletConnect 需要你自己在 Reown 申请的 Projec: WalletConnect requires your own Project ID from Reown. You can save it before configuring a chain. Browser extension wallets and mobile QR access do not require it.
Project ID 应为 32 位十六进制。: Project ID must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
正在读取当前部署支持的币种…: Loading tokens supported by the current deployment…
部署已切换，这份草稿已作废。: The deployment has changed. This draft is no longer valid.
将创建在部署“{0}”下。切换部署后这份草稿会被丢弃，不会带到其他链。: Will be created under deployment “{0}”. Switching deployments discards this draft; it will not carry over to another chain.
